create_gguf_reader: create a GGUFReader instance to parse a GGUF file and access its metadata and tensors
read_gguf_metadata: read key-value metadata fields from a GGUF file using get_field method
read_gguf_tensor_data: read tensor data from a GGUF file including shape, quantization type, and numpy array contents
extract_gguf_field_contents: extract contents from a ReaderField with support for strings, scalars, and arrays
parse_gguf_file_structure: parse a GGUF file header to validate magic number, version, byte order, and alignment
